Meet Timi Dawodu.

Also known as Timi the Genius.

I'm a Nigerian filmmaker, creative producer and multidisciplinary creative with a passion for storytelling, visual communication and building things.

My work sits at the intersection of creativity, technology, media and culture. I work across multiple creative disciplines, bringing ideas from concept to execution through direction, cinematography, photography, editing and content production.

I believe creativity should not be restricted by a lack of resources, access or opportunity. I'm interested in finding new ways to create, tell stories, collaborate and make meaningful work.

I'm also the founder of Genius Creative Brands, a Pan-African creative and media group working across multiple creative industries.

Multihyphenate Creative Polymath. I do many things and do them exceptionally well.

Enquire About Content Production

From enquiry to final delivery.

  1. Tell Me About Your Project

    Send an enquiry with a description of what you want to create, your objectives, timeline and any available references.

  2. Get a Proposal

    I'll review the requirements and provide a quotation covering the scope, deliverables, timeline and production costs.

  3. Confirm Your Booking

    A 50% deposit is required to secure a booking unless otherwise agreed in writing. The booking is confirmed once payment and the necessary arrangements are completed.

  4. Production Begins

    We move into the agreed creative and production process, keeping communication clear throughout the project.

  5. Review & Delivery

    You'll receive the agreed deliverables for review. Final files are released after the outstanding balance has been paid.

Frequently asked questions

Where are you based?

I'm based in Lagos, Nigeria, and available for projects across Nigeria and internationally.

Do you work outside Lagos?

Yes. Travel and accommodation requirements are included in the project quotation where applicable.

Can I hire you for just one service?

Yes. You can book individual services such as cinematography, directing, photography, editing or content production.

Can you handle an entire production?

Yes. Depending on the project, I can work with a production team and coordinate the creative and production requirements from development to delivery.

Are your prices fixed?

Published prices are starting rates. Final quotations depend on the project scope and requirements. Services marked as custom are priced individually.

Do you provide equipment?

Equipment requirements are discussed during project planning. Equipment rental and additional production resources are quoted separately where necessary.

How do I secure a booking?

A 50% deposit is required to secure a booking unless another payment arrangement has been agreed.

Do you offer revisions?

Yes. Editing packages include up to two reasonable revision rounds per deliverable. Additional revisions or changes to the original brief may attract additional fees.

How long does delivery take?

Turnaround time depends on the project scope and is confirmed in the quotation or production agreement.
